Vocabulary very inadequate; incorrect use of Hiragana and Katakana; writing difficult to decode; much use of Romaji; very limited range of structures used. Poor punctuation. Serious grammatical errors: Verb and adjective forms generally incorrect; particles generally incorrect; tense inconsistent, inappropriate

Vocabulary use quite good – generally adequate and appropriate with perhaps some Japanese idiom.
